title: Root AID Continuity Proof
description: Break-glass root-AID rotation continuity artifact. The old root's rot event seals the new root's inception SAID in field a, signed by the key it reveals; the new root's first ixn seals that rot's SAID. Each event is carried as the exact bytes that were signed (standard base64 of the event, as KERI serialises it) with every indexed signature on it, so a verifier holding only this document recomputes each SAID from the bytes and checks each signature: the new root's two events as a signed log of their own, the rot's signatures against the key the rot reveals. That the revealed key opens the old root's pre-rotation commitment is checked against the old root's key log, held by witnesses, watchers and contacts. The rot follows the last establishment event or an interaction the owner kept (prior_kel_tail_said) and supersedes the interactions after it.

old_root_aid.description: Compromised/restored root AID that authorized the handoff

new_root_aid.description: Fresh root AID founded by KERI inception during break-glass recovery

new_inception_said.description: SAID of the new root inception event sealed in the old-root authorization rot

new_inception_raw_b64.description: The new root's inception event, the exact bytes signed, in standard base64. Its key verifies the back-anchor event's signatures.

new_inception_signatures.description: Every indexed CESR signature on the new root's inception event

authorization_event_raw_b64.description: The old-root rot event, the exact bytes signed, in standard base64. Seals [{"d":"<new_inception_said>"}] in field a.

authorization_signatures.description: Every indexed CESR signature on the authorization rot event, as attached to it: the signature of the key the rot reveals, indexed by its place in the rot's key list

authorization_event_said.description: SAID of the authorization rot event: the digest of authorization_event_raw_b64

back_anchor_event_raw_b64.description: The new root's first ixn event, the exact bytes signed, in standard base64. Seals [{"d":"<authorization_event_said>"}]: the old root's tip after the rotation.

back_anchor_signatures.description: Every indexed CESR signature on the back-anchor ixn event

back_anchor_event_said.description: SAID of the back-anchor ixn event: the digest of back_anchor_event_raw_b64

prior_kel_tail_said.description: SAID of the event of the old root's log the authorization rot follows: its last establishment event or an interaction the owner kept. Interactions after it were superseded.

carry_forward_aids.description: Pairwise/contact AIDs the user chose to preserve across rotation
